```{r}
# Dependencies
if( !("dplyr" %in% installed.packages()) ){
  install.packages("dplyr")
}
library(dplyr)
if( !("kableExtra" %in% installed.packages()) ){
  install.packages("kableExtra")
}
library(kableExtra)
if( !("readr" %in% installed.packages()) ){
  install.packages("readr")
}
library(readr)

# Penn colors
colors_penn <- list(primary = c('#011f5b', '#990000'),
                    secondary = c('#3479be', '#faa755', '#bbd86b', '#bd60a5'),
                    gray = c('#555d6a', '#757f8f', '#a7aeba', '#e1e4ec'))
```

```{r}
# Load and filter data (data file with relevant course codes only)
dat <-
  read_csv('~/GitHub/course-reserves-stats/res/leganto-usage-views-2026-03-17.csv',
           name_repair = 'universal',
           col_types = cols(.default = 'c',
                            Event.date = 'D',
                            Course.enrollment = 'n',
                            Files.downloaded = 'n',
                            File.views = 'n',
                            Full.text.views = 'n',
                            Total.views = 'n'
                            )
           ) |>
  filter(User.role == 'Student')
```

```{r}
# Concatenate key course terms
term_min <- paste(dat$Course.term[dat$Event.date == min(dat$Event.date)][1],
                  dat$Course.year[dat$Event.date == min(dat$Event.date)][1])
term_max <- paste(dat$Course.term[dat$Event.date == max(dat$Event.date)][1],
                  dat$Course.year[dat$Event.date == max(dat$Event.date)][1])
```

These data cover courses from `{r} if (term_max == term_min) term_min else paste(term_min, "through", term_max)`.

## Summary by viewed item

Items that were viewed zero times do not appear.

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Number of views for each viewed item"
dat_temp <- dat |>
  group_by(Citation) |>
  summarize(Courses = length(unique(Course.code)),
            'Minimum\nenrollment' = min(Course.enrollment),
            'Maximum\nenrollment' = max(Course.enrollment),
            Views = sum(Total.views)
            ) |>
  arrange(Citation)
kbl(dat_temp,
    format = 'latex',
    col.names = linebreak(names(dat_temp)),
    escape = FALSE,
    longtable = TRUE
    ) |>
  kable_styling(c('striped'),
                latex_options = c('HOLD_position', 'repeat_header')
                )
```

```{r}
# Prepare view rates
dat_rate <- dat |>
  group_by(Citation, Course.code) |>
  summarize(Enrollment = median(Course.enrollment),
            Views = sum(Total.views)
            ) |>
  group_by(Citation) |>
  summarize(Courses = length(unique(Course.code)),
            'Median\nenrollment' = median(Enrollment),
            Views = sum(Views),
            'Views per\nstudent' = round(sum(Views) / sum(Enrollment), 2)
            ) |>
  arrange(desc(`Views per\nstudent`), .by_group = FALSE)
ct_under_1 <- nrow(dat_rate |> filter(`Views per\nstudent` < 1))
show_ct_under_1 <- ct_under_1 > 0
```

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Most-viewed and least-viewed items with views"
dat_temp <- dat_rate
if(nrow(dat_temp) > 10){
  dat_temp <- rbind(dat_temp[1:5, ],
                    rep("...", ncol(dat_temp)),
                    dat_temp[(nrow(dat_temp)-4):nrow(dat_temp), ]
                    )
}
kbl(dat_temp,
    format = 'latex',
    col.names = linebreak(names(dat_temp)),
    escape = FALSE,
    longtable = TRUE
    ) |>
  kable_styling(c('striped'),
                latex_options = c('HOLD_position', 'repeat_header')
                )
```

Out of all items with views, `{r} ct_under_1` `{r} if (ct_under_1 == 1) "item" else "items"` averaged below one view per student.

```{r}
#| include: !expr show_ct_under_1
#| tbl-cap: "Under-viewed items with views"
dat_temp <- dat_rate |> filter(`Views per\nstudent` < 1)
if(nrow(dat_temp) == 0){
  dat_temp <- rbind(dat_temp,
                    rep("N/A", ncol(dat_temp))
                    )
}
kbl(dat_temp,
    format = 'latex',
    col.names = linebreak(names(dat_temp)),
    escape = FALSE,
    longtable = TRUE
    ) |>
  kable_styling(c('striped'),
                latex_options = c('HOLD_position', 'repeat_header')
                )
```

## Summary by term

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Number of views by term"
dat_temp <- dat |>
  group_by(Course.year, Course.term) |>
  summarize(Courses = length(unique(Course.code)),
            'Viewed\nitems' = length(unique(Citation)),
            'Minimum\nenrollment' = min(Course.enrollment),
            'Maximum\nenrollment' = max(Course.enrollment),
            Views = sum(Total.views)
            ) |>
  arrange(Course.year, Course.term)
names(dat_temp)[c(1,2)] <- c('Course\nyear', 'Course\nterm')
kbl(dat_temp,
    format = 'latex',
    col.names = linebreak(names(dat_temp)),
    escape = FALSE,
    longtable = TRUE
    ) |>
  kable_styling(c('striped'),
                latex_options = c('HOLD_position', 'repeat_header')
                )
```

## Views by date (as needed)

```{r}
# Presets for histogram (hard-coded)
presets <- list(
  Term = c('Spring'),
  Year = c('2025'),
  Event = as.Date(c('2025-04-05'))
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Number of views by date"
if( !("ggplot2" %in% installed.packages()) ){
  install.packages("ggplot2")
}
library(ggplot2)

dates <- data.frame(Event.date = seq(from = as.Date(min(dat$Event.date)),
                                     to = as.Date(max(dat$Event.date)),
                                     by = "day"))
dat_temp <- dat |>
  filter(Course.term %in% presets$Term & Course.year %in% presets$Year) |>
  group_by(Event.date) |>
  summarize(Views = sum(Total.views))
dat_temp$Event.date <- as.Date(dat_temp$Event.date)
dat_temp <- left_join(dates, dat_temp) |> mutate_if(is.numeric, coalesce, 0)

ggplot(dat_temp,
       aes(x = Event.date,
           y = Views
           )
       ) +
  geom_col(fill = colors_penn$primary[1]) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = presets$Event,
             color = colors_penn$primary[2],
             linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = .5
             ) +
  annotate('text',
           label = presets$Event,
           color = colors_penn$primary[2],
           x = presets$Event,
           y = Inf,
           hjust = "top",
           vjust = "bottom",
           angle = 90
           ) +
  labs(x = 'Date') +
  theme_classic(base_family = "sans")
```
